intro.title: Company Profile
intro.p1: Shanghai Ningxin Trading Co., Ltd. is a China-focused precision manufacturing supply chain management company. We are not a factory — we are your Managed Sourcing Partner in China, helping global clients find, evaluate, and manage quality manufacturing suppliers.
intro.p2: Our core categories span precision metal parts (springs, stampings, MIM, CNC machining) and fiber & cable (single-mode/multi-mode fiber, power cables, conductors, control cables). Through rigorous supplier screening — on-site audits, technical evaluation, quality system review — we select only the Top 20% from 100+ candidate factories.
intro.p3: Our team brings 15+ years of precision manufacturing and engineering experience, delivering DFM reviews, tolerance analysis, FEA simulation, and full quality control. We serve clients across medical devices, industrial automation, 3C electronics, and telecommunications infrastructure.

products.title: Capabilities
products.subtitle: Integrated supply chain services across precision metal parts, fiber optics, and power cables

categories.name: Precision Springs
categories.desc: Through our vetted partner factories, we supply all types of precision springs. Partner facilities feature Taiwanese CNC coilers, CNC heat treatment furnaces, and automatic fatigue testers — covering micro springs to heavy industrial springs.
specs: Materials: Carbon/Alloy/Stainless steel, Music wire, Copper alloy

categories.name: Metal Stampings & Contacts
categories.desc: Partner factories equipped with 25T-200T precision presses and high-speed stamping lines. Products include contact clips, EMI shielding cans, precision terminals, retaining clips, and wave springs. In-house die development supports complex multi-station progressive tooling.

categories.name: MIM (Metal Injection Molding)
categories.desc: Full-process MIM production capability (feedstock → injection → debinding → sintering → post-processing) for complex precision parts in stainless and alloy steels. Complex geometries net-shaped in one forming process, eliminating secondary machining.

categories.name: CNC Precision Machining
categories.desc: Partner shops equipped with imported CNC turn-mill centers and 5-axis machines. Specializing in aluminum, stainless steel, titanium, and engineering plastic parts. Full lifecycle service from prototype to mass production.

categories.name: Single-Mode Fiber
categories.desc: In partnership with a global leading fiber manufacturer, we supply the full range of single-mode fiber products. Performance meets or exceeds all international standards for high-speed, long-distance communications.
specs: Series: Low water peak/Bend-insensitive/Ultra-low loss/Large effective area/NZ-DSF

categories.name: Multi-Mode Fiber
categories.desc: Full-range multi-mode fiber products, manufactured using advanced PCVD process for excellent DMD and bandwidth performance. From OM1 to the latest OM5 wideband fiber, supporting data center speed upgrades.
specs: Series: OM1 / OM2 / OM3 / OM4 / OM5

categories.name: Power Cables & Conductors
categories.desc: In partnership with a leading listed Chinese cable manufacturer, established in 1958, a comprehensive cable supplier and core supplier to State Grid and China Southern Power Grid for HV and EHV cables.
specs: Voltage: 500kV EHV to 0.6/1kV LV full range
